evidence.text: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name.
Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.
Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record.
Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
